title: Coaching decision
description: The coaching recommendation consumed by the DSA Prep Tracker. TWO INDEPENDENT VERSION FIELDS: `version` is the decision-document format and is currently 1. `outlookSchemaVersion` is the nextThreeDays contract and is currently 2. A day written with structured `scenarios` still lives inside a `version: 1` document — do not raise `version` to 2. Retention-policy version is a third, separate concept documented in docs/retention-policy.md and is not asserted by this schema.

version.description: Decision-document format version. Unrelated to outlookSchemaVersion.

outlookSchemaVersion.description: nextThreeDays contract. Omitted or 1 means legacy prose branches, which the app can only preview. 2 means structured scenarios the app can resolve automatically.

assessedAt.description: When the advice was authored. Distinct from the dates it plans for.

trackerSnapshot.description: What the coach saw when authoring. Used for freshness checks, never as a source of practice facts.

debt.description: Reported debt. `calculable: false` with a null score is the correct representation of no eligible cold evidence; zero would wrongly read as 'retention verified'.

nextThreeDays.description: Forecast days. Each entry is either a structured day (outlookSchemaVersion 2) or a legacy prose day.

branches.description: Display-only explanation of what each grade implies. Never drives branch selection.

evidence.description: Provenance of the judgements. A reference alone does not establish that the source was inspected.

localDate.description: Local calendar date. The app reads these at noon local time so they are never shifted by a UTC conversion.

practiceMode.description: Only `cold` attempts can establish delayed retention, and only when unaided and not a same-session repeat.

unresolved.description: Shown while a required result is still unknown.

legacyDay.description: outlookSchemaVersion 1. `conditional[].if` is prose, so the app cannot verify which branch applies and offers previews only.

dependency.description: Identified by explicit slug + local date + practice mode. The app never resolves a dependency as 'the most recent attempt anywhere' or by display label.

id.description: Referenced by conditions within this day.

priority.description: Ascending. The first scenario whose condition is true is selected. If a higher-priority condition is UNKNOWN, resolution stops there and the day reports 'Awaiting result' — it never falls through to a lower branch that assumes the unknown one is false. Give recovery the lowest number.

basis.description: Asserts a fact, so it is suppressed while previewing a hypothetical.

followUps.description: Information about later days. Displayed apart from the task list and never counted as problems for this day.

item.description: `type: 'problem'` counts toward workload; `type: 'action'` never does. When omitted, type defaults to 'problem' if a slug is present, otherwise 'action'.

minutes.description: Problem time only, not whole-session duration. Omit rather than guessing; the app reports 'time estimate incomplete' instead of treating a missing value as zero.

detail.description: Longer explanation, shown behind 'Why this task?'.

predicate.description: Conditions evaluate to true / false / unknown. Absent evidence is UNKNOWN, never false: 'no graded attempt found' does not prove the work was skipped. An unrecognised op puts the day into 'Needs review' rather than silently selecting a branch.

oneOf.description: True only when an explicit not-completed record exists. A missing attempt is unknown.
`all` is false if any part is false, otherwise unknown if any part is unknown. `any` is true if any part is true, otherwise unknown if any part is unknown.
Reads live anchor state, so a recovery branch follows the anchor that actually failed rather than a hard-coded slug.
True when that anchor is due, optionally only for a given last result.
